items.description: Signed DEs Zach Harrison and Khalid Kareem and S Jammie Robinson to the practice squad. Released DE Cameron Sample and DB Cobee Bryant from the practice squad.
Signed TE Qadir Ismail to the practice squad.
Signed WR Bryce Oliver to the practice squad.
Signed LS Scott Daly and K Lenny Krieg to the practice squad.

Signed WR Xavier Restrepo, S Jerrick Reed II, CB Erick Hallett II and LB Mohamoud Diabate to the practice squad. Released WR Hank Beatty, DB Derrick Canteen and LB Mani Powell from the practice squad.
Signed DT Marcus Harris to the practice squad. Released DT Cole Brevard from the practice squad.

Signed QB Max Brosmer, OLB Kyle Van Noy, RB Deejay Dallas and W Dillon Bell to the practice squad. Released OLB Cam'Ron Stewart, C Gavin Gerhardt, OL Tristan Leigh and G Joshua Gray from the practice squad.
Signed TE Shane Zylstra to the practice squad. Waived S Eric Butler and WR Jimmy Kibble from injured reserve.
Signed WR Kevin Austin and TE Treyton Welch to the practice squad.
Signed C Geno VanDeMark to the practice squad. Released DB J.T. Woods from the practice squad.
Signed S Bishop Fitzgerald to the practice squad.
Signed CB Kaiir Elam, DL Jordan Jefferson and WR Theo Wease to the practice squad. Released DL Jahmeer Carter, WR Devonte Ross and CB Isas Waxter from the practice squad.

Claimed CB Kevin Knowles off waivers from Kansas City. Signed TE CJ Dippre, CB Sean Murphy-Bunting and S Silas Walters to practice squad. Waived LB Caden Fordham. Released TE Devin Culp and S Rashad Wisdom.
Signed TE Nick Vannett to the practice squad.
Signed DT Junior Tafuna to the practice squad.
Placed LB JD Bertrand on injured reserve. Signed LB Josh Woods from the practice squad to the active roster.
Signed QB Josh Johnson, TE Tanner Hudson, CB Trikweze Bridges, OT Blake Freeland and DE Garmon Randolph to the practice squad.

Signed CB Noah Igbinoghene and DE Sam Williams to the active roster. Placed DT Kalia Davis on injured reserve. Waived CB Michael Coats Jr. Signed DTs Sam Kamara and Chris Williams, RB Jaleel McLaughlin and TE Messiah Swinson to the practice squad.
Signed QB Kedon Slovis to the practice squad.

Signed ILB Liam Anderson, EDGEs Clelin Ferrell, Amari Gainer and Max Llewellyn, DLs Jordan Miller and Mazi Smith, WR Will Sheppard, CBs Jaylin Simpson and Ethan Bonner and TE Tre Watson to the practice squad. Released QB Mark Gronowski, TE Jeremiah Franklin and ILB Cam Riley from the practice squad.
Signed TE Cam Grandy and DL Naquan Jones to the practice squad. Released TE Marshall Lang from the practice squad.
Re-signed C Ben Brown to the 53-man roster. Signed LB Erick Hunter to the 53-man roster. Signed LBs K.J. Britt and Jose Ramirez, DT Jalen Hunt and OL Jake Kubas to the practice squad.
Signed WR Danny Gray, OL Kiran Amegadjie, CB Robert Longerbeam and RB Jaydon Blue to the practice squad.
Signed DL Jared Harrison-Hunte and OL Vershon Lee to the practice squad.
Signed T Esa Pole, TEs Joshua Simon and Jack Westover and CB Isaac Yiadom to the practice squad.
